Landing.subtitle: Publish your cars for sale or rent on a clean page carrying your own name. Share a single QR code, and see exactly what buyers are looking at.
Landing.statMakes: car makes ready to pick from
Landing.statQr: QR code is all you print
Landing.featuresTitle: Everything a showroom needs, nothing it does not
Landing.featureShowroomBody: Your logo, your colour, your cars. Fast on mobile data, and built to be found.
Landing.featureQrBody: Print it, stick it on a windscreen, send it on WhatsApp. It always points at your latest inventory.
Landing.featureStatsBody: Which cars get opened, how many people visit, and how many tap through to WhatsApp.
Landing.featureImportBody: Pull across what you already advertise instead of typing it a second time.
Landing.featureBothBody: Sell a car with one price, or rent it by the day, the week or the month.
Landing.featureSoldBody: A sold car stays on your page with a badge. Your track record is the proof buyers want.
Landing.howTitle: Three steps to a live showroom
Landing.how1Body: You get your login details directly. Pick your own password the first time you sign in.
Landing.how2Body: Type them in, or import what you already have on Haraj in a few minutes.
Landing.how3Body: Print the QR or send it. It never goes stale, because it points at your live page.
Landing.harajTitle: Your Haraj ads, here in minutes
Landing.harajBody: We bring across what Haraj actually stores: the photos, the price, the year, the fuel and the transmission. Everything arrives as a draft for you to review, so nothing reaches your page until you approve it.
Landing.langTitle: Arabic by default, English when you want it
Landing.langBody: Choose your showroom languages during setup. Specifications like make, model, fuel and transmission are translated by us, so they read correctly in both languages without you writing anything twice.
Landing.faq1Q: Do I need any technical experience?
Landing.faq1A: No. You sign in, add a car, and share your link. That is the whole job.
Landing.faq2Q: What happens to cars I have sold?
Landing.faq2A: They stay on your showroom with a sold badge, because completed deals are proof of your work. You can hide any car whenever you like.
Landing.faq3Q: Can I sell and rent at the same time?
Landing.faq3A: Yes. Each car is listed for sale or for rent, and rental cars can carry daily, weekly and monthly rates.
Landing.faq4Q: How do I get an account?
Landing.faq4A: Accounts are created for you and handed over directly, so there is nothing to set up on your side.
Landing.ctaTitle: Ready to put your cars online?
Landing.ctaBody: Get in touch to have your agency account created.
Landing.footerTagline: Showrooms for car agencies in Saudi Arabia.

Import.title: Import from Haraj
Import.subtitle: Bring your existing Haraj listings across as drafts.
Import.noUsername: Your administrator has not linked a Haraj account to your agency yet.
Import.noUsernameHelp: Ask them to add your Haraj username so imports can run.
Import.runningHelp: You can leave this page, the import keeps running.
Import.howItWorksBody: Cars arrive as drafts, never published automatically. We copy across what Haraj actually stores: photos, price, year, fuel, transmission, condition and city. Haraj does not record the make, the model, or whether a car is for rent, so you fill those in yourself.
Import.warnCeiling: This import stopped at our safety limit, so it may be incomplete.
Import.warnNoTotal: Haraj does not report a total, so we cannot confirm every ad was seen.

Admin.title: Administration
Admin.slugHelp: Appears in the URL and in every QR code: {example}
Admin.slugFormat: Use 3–40 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes
Admin.harajHelp: Paste the link to their Haraj profile, for example https://haraj.com.sa/users/… . The account name on its own works too. Only you can set this: it is what stops an agency importing someone else's inventory.
Admin.credentialsHelp: This password is shown once and cannot be recovered. Copy it and send it to the agency, they will be asked to change it when they first sign in.
Admin.suspendConfirm: Suspend {name}? Their showroom goes offline immediately and they cannot sign in.
Admin.resetPasswordConfirm: Generate a new temporary password for {name}?
Admin.impersonateHelp: You will be signed in as this agency. This is recorded in the audit log.

Admin.pendingRequestsHelp: Names agencies typed because the catalog was missing them. Approve to add them for everyone.
